text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text, so they can find meaning in what people write. NLP is also used for translation, which helps us communicate across different languages. Another important use is sentiment analysis, where computers discover whether a piece of text is positive, negative or neutral. You can see this when companies check customer reviews online. Finally, NLP powers chatbots, the programs that answer our questions on websites. Thanks to NLP, these tools can reply in a natural and helpful way.
